data.title: Income tax assessment 2024 – refund €767
data.summary: Finanzamt Beispielhausen issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2024 on 27 October 2025. It results in a refund of €767.00, to be paid to the known bank account.
data.explanation: This is your income tax assessment for 2024. Tax of €7,012.00 was set, but €7,779.00 was already withheld from your salary, so you get €767.00 back. The refund should be paid in the next few days to the account the tax office already has. If you disagree with the assessment, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline. Check the figures against your tax return. If you don't object, the assessment becomes final. A tax adviser can help if unsure.
